hierarchy.notes: A public registry intelligence instrument that separates endpoint-verified, usable-with-caveats, and planned provider coverage before exposing searchable setup actions.

allowed_side_effects: user-initiated local filter and pagination state
user-initiated navigation to public contribution documentation

classification.notes: The route renders compile-time public registry metadata only; it makes no provider calls, usage writes, uploads, or database requests.

ssa_v2.notes: Server composition, pure search and pagination, client interaction, table styling, and route styling are isolated; every owned source file stays below 300 lines.

ssi.notes: The server route passes the public registry into one client directory while a pure module owns status precedence, search relevance, AND facets, and bounded pagination.

sstf.notes: Eight pure directory and coverage-brief contracts plus the provider surface suite cover precedence, fail-closed states, search, filters, pagination, density, direct brief actions, and route boundaries.

spe.notes: Derivation is linear across the compile-time registry and the browser renders at most the selected bounded page size; the coverage vector is computed once from the same normalized directory data.

srs.notes: The first read now explains verified, caveated, and planned coverage, quantifies endpoint confidence, and opens the exact evidence lane while search, empty results, pagination, and clipboard failures remain visible.

ssra.notes: Guarded deploy 6a5730398589be5015916660 with stamp mrlqeaz3-70zvxvrt passed the full release gate, 30-route build, stable and immutable interaction proof, and zero-overflow browser checks at 390x844, 1440x1000, and 3840x2160; production was re-locked after verification.

sas.notes: The route has an explicit owned-path manifest, active SMA lease evidence, and route-local files with no shared-contract edits.

sva.notes: The route consumes public compile-time metadata only and performs no provider fetch, secret access, persistent browser storage, usage mutation, or upload.

srls.notes: The brick does not access a database.

sev.notes: The brick requires no environment variables.

ssc.notes: Next and React are inherited from the web package; this slice adds no runtime dependency.

sai.notes: The provider and test leases, intent, owned paths, gates, deployment, and browser proof are recorded.

code_budget.notes: The route is split into server composition, a pure tested data model, one client directory, three focused stylesheets, theatre, and tests with no new dependency.
